kurbaitaev-ghost-editor-root.description: AI video editor for talking-head reels. Turns a raw phone recording of someone talking to camera (retakes, pauses, false starts) into a finished vertical 1080x1920 reel for Instagram, TikTok or Shorts: the best take of each sentence, pause trimming, word-timed captions that never cover the face, motion scenes on the spoken word, sound effects mixed against the voice and checked B-roll.
